claim: The official Alpaca-py TradeAccount reference describes accrued_fees as account-level accrued fees, an optional string field. It is not a per-order or final all-future-fees certificate.
impact_on_spec: Receive the actual authenticated account field with its timestamp and complete cash/activity prefix. Missing and zero differ. Do not manufacture per-order completeness from a current account value.
limitations: Reference gives a generic field description. pending_reg_taf_fees additive/overlap semantics and eventual charge timing are not established by this SDK description. No broker request was made.

claim: Alpaca regulatory-fee documentation says pending regulatory charges are tracked intraday and deducted from account balances, with fees charged at end of day and rounded to currency precision.
impact_on_spec: Preserve whether a charge is already embedded in broker cash before modeling or subtracting it again. A nonzero aggregate field requires supported attribution and inclusion treatment.
limitations: General documentation is not proof that this particular paper account has completed all fee postings, nor a guarantee of paper simulation parity. No rate or universal zero-paper-fee assumption is imported. Actual saved receipts outrank a blanket no-fees narrative.

claim: Official account-activities documentation distinguishes FILL from non-trade FEE events, describes signed net_amount and activity date, and documents ascending page-token pagination.
impact_on_spec: Receive complete actual activity pages and exact IDs through the recorded capture. Keep fee/dividend/cash events separate from fills and preserve their effective and observed clocks.
limitations: An activity date may refer to occurrence or settlement; it is not a universal public-arrival clock. A complete currently received page prefix and absence of a FEE row do not prove no subsequent fee posting.
